_note: Story beats (scripts/core/story.gd, autoload Story). rogue = 'The rogue and the missing Wick'. Part A: when a border patrol is fully marked (phase report) and at least after_border_patrols border patrols have been marked by then (this one included), the cat `missing` goes missing (flag wick_missing) unless it is on that patrol; the deputy's report then gives the news (flag rogue_news) once. While the investigation runs the deputy offers no patrols and the goal line shows goal_investigate (a strings.json key).

rogue._rogue_note: Part B. The rogue (npc, in area; its layout gives it a when) talks by the river. Choices set rogue_choice; the last line sets rogue_met. Then: question = he walks off along route (its first point = where he stands) at walk_speed; threaten = he runs off at run_speed and the route is marked with scent rings every trail_every px; bribe = he takes the prey, stays, and an arrow (way_mark) shows the story exit. The exit (exit id in area) has when rogue_met.
rogue._camp_note: Part C. camp_area: the rogue camp, where Wick is (absent from every other area). Hiding behind its log plays cutscene, which sets rogue_camp_found; goal_warn until the deputy is told (rogue_warned).
